payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the inference models used to estimate socioeconomic status (SES) from online behavioral data, particularly from Twitter users in France.

claims.text: The inference models for estimating socioeconomic status rely on three datasets: socioeconomic census data, crawled profession information, and expert annotated Google Street View images of users' home locations.
The models utilize user semantics, demographic features, and professional classifications to predict income, occupation, and socioeconomic class.
The proposed methods aim to provide a generalizable framework for estimating SES from broadly available datasets.
